decisive_items: two great vessels arising in parallel from the right ventricle
severe dilation of the right atrium and right ventricle
a markedly hypoplastic left ventricle with a severely reduced mitral valve orifice
response.rationale: R7 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including the characteristic two great vessels arising from the right ventricle, severe dilation of the right atrium and ventricle, and a hypoplastic left ventricle. R4 is the runner-up because it also has some support from the vignette, but lacks the key feature of two great vessels arising from the right ventricle.

lacks key features of Ebstein's anomaly, such as atrialization of the right ventricle
